contracts: (The selector is discovered and confirms no requester ownership or adoption side effect for orphan input.) AND (The selector is discovered and verifies persisted quarantine plus exclusion from normal ownership queries.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and confirms no requester owner or adoption side effect in persisted metadata.)
selector_intents: Run the ambiguous-ownership selector and fail if quarantine is absent or the record remains normally usable.
Run the conflicting-ownership metadata selector and fail if requester ownership or adoption is persisted.
Run the orphan-ownership selector and fail if requester ownership or automatic adoption is persisted.
